entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Including the day we gotta[n]carry out the plan, there's[n]only eleven days left.
entries.uk: Разом із днем, коли треба[n]виконати план, лишилося[n]всього одинадцять днів.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Time is really slipping away.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: What will happen to us[n]if we fail...?
entries.uk: Що буде з нами,[n]якщо ми провалимося...?

entries.en: We won't fail.
Our lives will be over.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's kinda tough to say[n]that for sure though.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wow, you said it so plainly.
entries.uk: Ого, ти так прямо це сказав.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: According to Akechi-kun, we'd be[n]tried for very serious crimes.
entries.uk: Акечі казав, що нас судитимуть[n]за дуже тяжкі злочини.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Maybe, but we can't lose heart[n]before we've even done anything.
entries.uk: Може, але не можна падати духом,[n]ще нічого не зробивши.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: If we do that, we'll just mess[n]everything up, even the parts[n]we can definitely succeed in.
entries.uk: Бо тоді ми все зіпсуємо,[n]навіть те, що точно[n]могло б вдатися.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm, you actually said[n]something wise for once.
entries.uk: Хм, ти хоч раз сказала[n]щось мудре.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: You wanna fight!?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: You two get along so well.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Uh, how so?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That is an outrageous claim.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: That's what I should be saying!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Come on, stop it.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Let's try to keep tensions low.[n]We're all feeling anxious.
entries.uk: Не нагнітаймо. Ми всі[n]й так хвилюємося.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Even you, Makoto?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yes. It can't really be[n]helped this time.
entries.uk: Так. Цього разу інакше[n]й не буває.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: That's not how I raised you.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Get a hold of yourself, Ryuji!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Why're you singling me out...?
entries.uk: Чого це ти до мене чіпляєшся...?
